scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT a.*
FROM bronze.admissions a
WHERE TRY_CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.patient_id)) AS INT) IN (
    SELECT patient_id 
    FROM silver.patients
)',

admission_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(toString(admission_date)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(toString(admission_date)), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(admission_date)), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(admission_date)), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(admission_date)), 'MM-dd-yy'))) ~> derivedColumn1

derivedColumn1 derive(discharge_date = coalesce(toDate(trim(toString(discharge_date)), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(toString(discharge_date)), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(discharge_date)), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(discharge_date)), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(toString(discharge_date)), 'MM-dd-yy')),

department = case(isNull(department) || trim(toString(department)) == '', 'Unknown', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'onco') > 0, 'Oncology', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'cardio') > 0, 'Cardiology', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'emerg') > 0 || lower(trim(toString(department))) == 'er', 'Emergency', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'ped') > 0 || instr(lower(toString(department)), 'paed') > 0, 'Pediatrics', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'surg') > 0, 'General Surgery', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'neur') > 0 || instr(lower(toString(department)), 'nuer') > 0, 'Neurology', instr(lower(toString(department)), 'orth') > 0, 'Orthopedics', initCap(trim(toString(department)))),

derivedColumn2 derive(admission_date = toString(     coalesce(         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate('1900-01-01', 'yyyy-MM-dd')     ),     'yyyy-MM-dd' ),

discharge_date = toString(     coalesce(         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(toString(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MM-dd-yy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(toString(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate('1900-01-01', 'yyyy-MM-dd')     ),     'yyyy-MM-dd' )) ~> derivedColumn3
